presidential_approval._note: Computed live from potus-approval.csv by environment.py — this block is a fallback only and is overridden at runtime.
presidential_approval.source: potus-approval.csv weighted average (989 polls in file, 896 inside the 540-day window, half-life 21d, through 8/28/26)

economy.gdp_source: BEA Q2 2026 second estimate (released 8/26/26): +1.5% annualized, unchanged from the advance estimate, with consumer spending revised up to 3.4%. Down from Q1 2026's +2.1% third estimate. Q2 third estimate due late September 2026; the Q3 advance estimate in late October is the last GDP print before the election.
economy.consumer_sentiment_source: University of Michigan, August 2026 final (released 8/28/26): 51.7, down about 6% from July's 55.2 and about 11% below a year ago, confirming the early-month reading amid continued worries that inflation will stay elevated. Verified against the Surveys of Consumers monthly series (sca.isr.umich.edu/files/tbmics.csv). Next release Sept 11, 2026.
economy.unemployment_source: BLS Employment Situation, July 2026 (released 8/7/26). U-3 fell to 4.1% from 4.2%, but for a weak reason — payrolls fell 23k, May and June were revised down 103k combined, and the participation rate dropped to 61.4%. Note: unemployment is carried for display only; national_environment_shift() does not read it.
